intro: Dwarven Digging is a quest in Mulgore given by Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village. Concerned that dwarven excavations will enrage the native beasts and defile the sacred earth, Baine tasks young Horde defenders with sabotaging their efforts by confiscating and shattering their pickaxes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest. They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.
Collect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.
You can smash the tools at a forge. You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge—even a forge at the dwarven camp—will suffice.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Do you have the Broken Tools? The dwarves' digging will enrage the kodos of Mulgore. This defilement must be stopped!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. This will calm the beasts of Mulgore. And, spirits willing, it will teach the dwarves that hollowing the land is not the path to knowledge.
